title: Dandelion Growth Stages
description: Gives dandelions a taller variant and a "growth stage".
body:
![About](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19d332cdab77737cd016fd7c1ae13efef260cbc7_0.webp)

**Dandelion Growth Stages** tries to mimic the real-life lifecycle of a dandelion by giving it 2 types. There are tall versions for each type making it 4 total variants. 

![Important](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/708a3309f064bdc0462316fb25f4247f45266f6d_0.webp)

This resource pack is intended to work with any version above Minecraft 26.1 Snapshot 7, since any block can support "translucent" (partially transparent/semi-transparent) textures.
